step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram represents Mesh Korea's A/B Testing Platform. In the API boundary, EKS runs the application service scaling deployment objects and reads/writes to ElastiCache Redis for fast response times. Real-time metric data from ElastiCache is streamed to OpenSearch (Elasticsearch) and visualized in Kibana, while also being backed up directly into S3. In the Metrics layer, service data from RDS is processed by EMR, orchestrated by Apache Airflow, and refined data is written to S3. In the Analytics layer, S3 data is queried using Amazon Athena to power a BI Dashboard for analyzing A/B testing results.

graph.name: Mesh Korea A/B Testing Platform Architecture
graph.notes: Mesh Korea built an A/B testing platform handling 10,000 QPS. It runs microservices on EKS, relies on ElastiCache Redis for fast caching, uses Elasticsearch and Kibana for real-time streaming metrics, orchestrates EMR batch refining via Apache Airflow from RDS data into S3, and analyzes final metrics via Athena and a BI Dashboard.

nodes.name: EKS
nodes.notes: Runs the customized Sixpack core engine and API service instances, managing up to 10,000 QPS with Kubernetes deployment object auto-scaling.

nodes.name: ELASTICACHE
nodes.notes: ElastiCache Redis serves as the fast low-latency data store for A/B test experiments and feature deployment configs.

nodes.name: ELASTICSEARCH
nodes.notes: Receives real-time log and metric data streamed from ElastiCache for indexing and fast search.

nodes.name: KIBANA
nodes.notes: Third-party visualization tool connected to Elasticsearch for real-time monitoring of metrics.

nodes.name: AIR FLOW
nodes.notes: Apache Airflow deployed on EKS orchestrates periodic data ingestion and refining workflows.

nodes.name: RDS
nodes.notes: Relational database storing relational service data used during experiment evaluation.

nodes.name: EMR
nodes.notes: Elastic MapReduce cluster used for heavy batch ETL and data refinement.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Central object storage for streaming logs and refined metrics data.

nodes.name: ATHENA
nodes.notes: Interactive query service used to analyze experiment results stored in S3.

nodes.name: BI DASHBOARD
nodes.notes: Visualization dashboard displaying A/B test analysis results derived from Athena queries.

edges.notes: EKS application service uses ElastiCache Redis as low-latency cache/storage.
ElastiCache streams real-time log and metric data directly to Elasticsearch.
Elasticsearch feeds index data to Kibana for real-time dashboarding.
ElastiCache simultaneously streams real-time metric logs into S3 for storage.
Apache Airflow orchestrates periodic data refining jobs running on EMR.
RDS service data is ingested into EMR for refining and processing.
EMR outputs refined metrics and processed data into S3.
Data stored in S3 is queried using Amazon Athena.
Athena query results feed A/B test analysis metrics into the BI Dashboard.
